description: Manage scoped skills and platform-skill activation. Actions: list (your skills, team skills, releases); delete (remove a user/team/local skill — the final content is archived locally first); release (deactivate a PLATFORM skill you never use, freeing host catalog budget — per user, or per team by admins); restore (re-activate a released platform skill; lossless).

scope.description: delete: where the skill lives; release/restore: user (yourself) or team (admin)

name: skill_manage
